annotation.summary_en: A psychiatrist tests three mental hospital patients to see if their treatment is working, only for the 'cured' patient to reveal a hidden prank.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch takes place in a bright hospital office where a bespectacled doctor in a white coat and surgical cap is evaluating three patients dressed in hospital gowns. The doctor explains that after three months of treatment, he wants to check their progress by asking them about their 'pets.' Two of the patients, Spartak and Misha, hold up bandaged stone blocks as if they are small dogs, naming them 'Tuzik' and 'Graf.' The doctor plays along, noting that their medication seems to be working. However, when he asks the third patient, Suren, for his dog's name, Suren looks at his bandaged object in disbelief and correctly identifies it as a brick ('kyarpinj'). Overjoyed that one patient has finally returned to reality, the doctor immediately discharges him and calls security to finalize the paperwork. The final scene shifts to the exterior of the building, where Suren meets with his friends outside. As he prepares to drop his brick from a window, he reveals the truth to his 'dog' by saying, 'We really fooled the doctor, didn't we, Tuzik?'
